描述_EN: the wares produced at the yaozhou kiln complex enjoyed popularity from the end of the tang dynasty (618-906) through to the beginning of the yuan dynasty (1279-1368), however, this incense burner exhibits the green glaze and stoneware body produced there during the northern song (960-1127) and jin (1115-1234) dynasties. when applied, the glaze pooled into any crevices and ran thin over the raised areas and at the edges. the glaze that gives the green hue and shiny texture to this object is known as a celadon. celadons are feldspathic glazes which derive their colour from the presence of iron oxide when fired in a reduction atmosphere (one with very little oxygen). after firing, areas where the glaze ran thick were an opaque olive green and the thinly covered surfaces emerged a paler hue. in this case, the glaze is crazed slightly, meaning that during firing, the body expanded further than the glaze, giving an underlying crackled texture to the shiny surface of the glaze. this incense burner is an example of yaozhou wares.
描述_ZN: 从唐朝末年（618-906）到元朝初年（1279-1368），耀州窑群生产的器物一直很受欢迎，然而，这个香炉展示了北宋（960-1127）和金朝（1115-1234）时期生产的绿釉和石器身。 当应用时，釉料汇集到任何缝隙中，并在凸起的地方和边缘处变薄。 赋予该器物绿色色调和光泽纹理的釉料被称为青瓷。 青瓷是一种长石质的釉料，当在还原气氛（含氧量极少）中烧制时，其颜色来自于氧化铁的存在。 烧制后，釉面厚的地方是不透明的橄榄绿，而薄的表面则出现了较淡的色调。 在这种情况下，釉面出现了轻微的裂纹，这意味着在烧制过程中，器身比釉面进一步膨胀，使釉面的光亮表面出现了潜在的裂纹纹理。 这个香炉是耀州器物的一个例子。
